derived_candidates.text: Rocky Mountain Arsenal was operated by the United States Army throughout its history.
The M34 grenade was manufactured by Rocky Mountain Arsenal from the late 1950s, indicating Army operation during that period.
Basin F was a waste disposal basin at Rocky Mountain Arsenal used for chemical weapons production.
The late 20th century timeframe for Basin F operation aligns with the Army's ongoing management of Rocky Mountain Arsenal.
